$comment: All durable harness state, owned by the CLI (./AGENTS.sh) — never hand-edit. Keys: setup (present only while guided setup is pending; init drives it), commands (via `cmd set/rm`; verify = definition-of-done step, init = session-start check), features (via `feature ...`; max one in_progress, never delete — mark done), progress (via `log`; append-only, display bounded by the CLI), rules (via `docs add/rm`; curated project knowledge). Future harness versions may add top-level keys. Transient scratch lives in agents.scratch.json (gitignored).

features.title: Complete guided project setup
features.notes: Driven by ./AGENTS.sh init (SETUP MODE); closes itself when setup finalizes.

features.title: Toolchain + Cloudflare scaffold + verify commands
features.notes: npm create cloudflare react, deps (jose octokit zod vitest), wrangler.jsonc, D1, migrations/0001_init.sql, register cmd lint/test/build --verify. Phase 0.

features.title: Phase 1: private dashboard shell
features.notes: React UI, Access JWT validation in worker, D1 connected, /api/me + /api/health, dashboard layout. Dev auth bypass via x-dev-user-email (APP_ENV=development only).

features.title: Phase 2: Jules source browser
features.notes: JulesProvider client w/ pagination + redaction, /api/jules/sources, UI lists sources+branches.

features.title: Phase 3: repo config CRUD
features.notes: Add/edit repo_configs from Jules source: prompt, branch, quota, runtime, run window, auto-merge mode. Enable/disable. Saved disabled by default.

features.title: Phase 4: manual run (no merge)
features.notes: Run-now -> run row -> AutopilotRunnerWorkflow creates Jules session, polls to terminal, stores run_events, shows session URL.

features.title: Phase 5: PR tracking (no merge)
features.notes: Extract PR url from session outputs, parse owner/repo/number, add autopilot + autopilot:jules labels, PR comment, show PR in UI.

features.title: Phase 6: CI-aware safe merge
features.notes: GitHub App auth, prSafety.ts checks mergeability+checks+sha, merge only if safe w/ head sha. auto_merge_enabled off by default.

features.title: Phase 7: scheduler
features.notes: 5-min cron tick, per-repo lock, daily quota (attempts), min_delay, run window, auto run creation w/ deterministic workflow id.

features.title: Phase 8: cleanup + manual controls
features.notes: cancel run, retry, close tracked PR, global pause, manual_review_required state.

features.title: Phase 9: multi-agent registry
features.notes: Later: agent provider registry, second provider behind AgentProvider.

progress.title: project setup
progress.done: setup complete: 0 command(s) registered, 10 feature(s) seeded, 7 rule(s) recorded

rules.text: Cloudflare Worker (worker/) serves React SPA (src/) + /api/*; durable runs in Cloudflare Workflows (AutopilotRunnerWorkflow); D1 = repo_configs/runs/repo_locks/daily_counters/run_events; 5-min cron tick wakes scheduler.
Agents behind AgentProvider interface (worker/agents/); JulesProvider first. Jules API base https://jules.googleapis.com/v1alpha, auth x-goog-api-key. No session delete/cancel endpoint.
GitHub via App installation token (worker/github/), generated on demand (1h expiry), cached in memory not D1. PR safety gate in prSafety.ts.
wrangler.jsonc not .toml. Secrets via wrangler secret put, never vars/D1/code. Redact api keys + auth headers in all errors/logs.
Per-repo single active run enforced via repo_locks. Count attempts not merges against daily quota. Quota date uses repo timezone (default Europe/Brussels).
Merge only Autopilot-owned PRs: tracked run pr_url + autopilot/autopilot:jules label + matching repo. Pass head sha on merge. Never touch human PRs.

Vitest. Cover: Access JWT missing/wrong-email -> 403; secret redaction; scheduler skip (disabled/locked/quota/window) + starts exactly one workflow; workflow session lifecycle + lock release; PR safety (no label, failing/pending/null checks never merge; sha mismatch blocks); D1 atomic quota + lock replace.
